# Java ImageIO verdicts for every JPEG fixture in `crates/audiveris-jpeg`, plus
# the corpus page. Generated by `oracle/java/JpegVerdicts.java` on JDK 21.0.10.
#
# This pins the half of parity that sample comparison cannot see: which files
# decode at all. A decoder that accepts a file Audiveris rejects produces an
# image where Audiveris produces an error, and every sample in it agrees with
# nothing. Differential fuzzing found four such files, each of them a place where
# libjpeg validates something this decoder did not.
#
# <path> <TAB> accept <width> <height> <bands>
# <path> <TAB> reject <ImageIO message>
